import pytest
from store.cart import Cart, Item


def _mug_cart_3(price_cents=1500):
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=price_cents, qty=1))
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=price_cents, qty=1))
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=price_cents, qty=1))
    return cart


def test_issue_partial_remove_decreases_qty():
    """With a qty, decrease the line by that many units."""
    cart = _mug_cart_3(price_cents=1500)
    cart.remove("MUG", 1)
    assert cart.items[0].qty == 2  # 3-1=2


def test_issue_exact_qty_removes_line():
    """Removing the line when it reaches zero."""
    cart = _mug_cart_3(price_cents=1500)
    cart.remove("MUG", qty=3)
    assert len(cart.items) == 0  # 3-3=0


def test_issue_remove_two_leaves_single():
    """With a qty, decrease the line by that many units."""
    cart = _mug_cart_3(price_cents=1500)
    cart.remove("MUG", 2)
    assert cart.items[0].qty == 1  # 3-2=1


def test_issue_remove_more_than_qty_raises():
    """Removing more units than are in the cart raises KeyError."""
    cart = _mug_cart_3(price_cents=1500)
    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
        cart.remove("MUG", 4)  # 4>3


def test_issue_no_qty_removes_whole_line():
    """With no qty, remove the whole line."""
    cart = _mug_cart_3(price_cents=1500)
    cart.remove("MUG")
    assert len(cart.items) == 0  # 3 units removed at once


def test_issue_missing_sku_raises():
    """A SKU that is not in the cart raises KeyError."""
    cart = _mug_cart_3(price_cents=1500)
    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
        cart.remove("HAT")


def test_issue_empty_cart_remove_with_qty_raises():
    """A SKU that is not in the cart raises KeyError."""
    cart = Cart()
    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
        cart.remove("MUG", qty=1)  # empty cart has 0 units


def test_issue_partial_remove_updates_subtotal():
    """Subtotal is the sum of price_cents * qty after partial remove."""
    cart = _mug_cart_3(price_cents=1500)
    cart.remove("MUG", 1)
    assert cart.subtotal_cents() == 3000  # 1500*2=3000


def test_contract_subtotal_sums_lines():
    """Subtotal is the sum of price_cents * qty over every line."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=1200, qty=1))
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=1200, qty=1))
    cart.add(Item(sku="HAT", name="Hat", price_cents=800, qty=1))
    assert cart.subtotal_cents() == 3200  # 1200*2+800*1=3200


def test_contract_percent_coupon_rounds_down():
    """A percent coupon takes that percent off the whole subtotal, rounded down."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="PEN", name="Pen", price_cents=199, qty=1))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    assert cart.discount_cents() == 19  # 199*10//100=19


def test_contract_empty_cart_no_shipping():
    """An empty cart has no shipping charge."""
    cart = Cart()
    assert cart.shipping_cents() == 0  # empty->0


def test_contract_tax_rounds_half_up():
    """Tax is 8% of the discounted subtotal, rounded half up."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="PEN", name="Pen", price_cents=199, qty=1))
    assert cart.tax_cents() == 16  # (199*8+50)//100=16
